## Agenda

- Recap quiz: Session 6
- 7.1  Protocol, ethics, consent, registration, feasibility
- 7.2  Research integrity: authorship, conflicts of interest, data sharing, AI
- Proposal builder 7: ethics + publication plan
- 7.3  Writing the paper (I): Methods, Results, tables, STROBE
- Manuscript workshop 1: draft Methods + Results

## Timetable

| Start | Clock* | Min | Segment |
|:----|:----|---:|:------------------------------------------------------------|
| 0:00 | 08:00 | 10 | Recap quiz |
| 0:10 | 08:10 | 30 | **7.1 Protocol, ethics and consent:** protocol (SPIRIT), Helsinki & GCP, ethics committee journey, consent incl. ICU consent, registration, confidentiality, feasibility |
| 0:40 | 08:40 | 20 | **7.2 Research integrity:** FFP, duplicate/salami, authorship & CRediT, conflicts of interest, data sharing, AI use |

| 1:15 | 09:15 | 15 | BREAK |
| 1:30 | 09:30 | 35 | **7.3 Writing the paper (I):** writing order, Methods (incl. statistical paragraph), Results (participants first, numbers with CIs, no interpretation), stand-alone tables & figures, STROBE for the course-dataset paper |
| 2:05 | 10:05 | 50 | **[DS] Manuscript workshop 1:** each group drafts Methods + Results (~600 words) with Table 1 and one figure/table from its results pack |
| 2:55 | 10:55 | 5 | Wrap-up |

\*Times are relative to the start of the session; the clock column shows an example 08:00–11:00 session. **[DS]** = course-dataset content (FLUID-ICU analysis and manuscript writing).

## Before this session

- Proposal Part 3 finished; presentation started.
- Your group's results pack and Table 1 at hand for the manuscript workshop.

## After this session (homework)

- **Group:** finish Proposal Part 4 and your 6-slide presentation.
- Re-read your Methods + Results draft.
- Read the abstracts of Papers 1 and 2 the evening before Session 8 (for *Be the reviewer*).
- The integrity scenarios on the Session 7 sheet that were not done in class.
